summary: The registered remediation closes the prior P1 strict-support provenance failure. Every current artifact with a non-null scientific_result--the modulation result, mask control, MC-resolution report, result card, and artifact manifest--contains the same exact frozen support object: 40 < L < 763, integer L=41..762, count 722, endpoints excluded, Equatorial. The producer applies a generic fail-closed result_support_errors check to every non-null result, the result pack is rejected on any mismatch, and the support-loss/drift mutations for mask, MC, and manifest are all killed within a 23/23 mutation report. The deep replay remains process/provenance evidence with scientific_result=null and NOT_EVALUATED_PROVENANCE_REPLAY_ONLY. The closed terminal remains an internal, public_use=false, transfer_source=none, ACT-release-simulation-conditional C3 result with exactly-400, mask-control, finite-resolution, and no-physical-interpretation caveats. No affirmative raw-QE/RDN0, detection, isotropy, physical or causal attribution, transfer/native, geometry, or family promotion was found. This PASS closes artifact-scope remediation only and does not upgrade the scientific claim.

The generic validator is invoked after manifest construction, so the manifest cannot bypass the check. Three executed mutations demonstrate absence and drift rejection on the previously defective surfaces; the direct regression test enumerates all five result-bearing artifacts. No unresolved P0, P1, or P2 claim finding remains in this assignment slice.
